prompt: Два процесса не должны одновременно попадать в критическую секцию. Проверь эту модель: Promela - examples/CH2/mutex_flaw.pml
expected_output: Invariant violated; status `violated`, evidence `exhaustive`; counterexample decoded through labels L1–L4 with both users at L7; cause class: system defect; the report's engine/inputs sections (manifest) attached; no forbidden phrasing.
engine: mcd 0.1.0-g0 built from model-check-plugin/engine at commit a51ce00 (go build -o ${TMP_DIR}/mcd ./cmd/mcd)

protocol.executor: one general-purpose subagent per configuration, run in parallel, same model as the coordinating session
protocol.with_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory + path of skills/model-check/SKILL.md ('follow it literally, including the references') + path of the built binary ${TMP_DIR}/mcd; told that the MCP server is not registered (CLI fallback of SKILL.md step 3)
protocol.without_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory only (as in iteration-1)
protocol.mcp: not exercised: an MCP server cannot be registered into a subagent's session dynamically; every engine call went through the mcd CLI
protocol.questions: the user is not available; both configurations were told to record an explicitly labelled assumption instead of asking
protocol.grading: evals-workspace/grader.py over outputs/answer.md and the outputs directory; assertions from skills/model-check/evals/evals.json
protocol.timing: tokens, duration and tool uses copied from the Agent task-completion notifications; no other measurement

with_skill.reason: verbatim copies of corpus files (plan 14 §2.1 licence note: the corpus is referenced by path and SHA-256, never copied) and, for the E1 baseline, SPIN-generated C sources and pan executables; removed by the coordinator after grading inputs were fixed — grading uses outputs/answer.md only for this eval
